title: people settings
description: Operator settings for the people module (company.yaml modules.people). Secrets (API token, webhook secret, encryption keys) are never settings; can-core generates them as Secrets.

retention.description: Per data class retention, counted from the day a person becomes former (1:1 meetings and closed goals also expire by age). Review against local employment and data-protection law; the defaults are not advice.

reviews.description: Review defaults. Leave entitlements and statutory rules vary by jurisdiction: leave types, accruals, holidays and blackouts are data entered through the API, not settings, and no legal rule is built in. This is a tool, not legal or HR advice.

min_responses.description: Default number of feedback answers needed before any feedback about a person is shown. Never below 3: fewer could identify the authors. A cycle can raise it.

x-can.risk: fewer answers hide who gave feedback

idle_minutes.description: Web UI: sign out after this many minutes without activity (default 30).

x-can.risk: idle web sessions stay signed in longer

absolute_hours.description: Web UI: the longest a session lasts (default 8).
